info.cls_name: 智能工程碩專二學位學程
info.cls_ename: Professional Master's Program for Intelligent Manufacturing and Engineering Management

description.describe_ch: 為了實現永續社會的發展，工業和服務業必須了解如何應對環境、經濟和社會挑戰，並改變其行為模式。這門課程介紹了該領域的最新思想和知識，並探討了加速向永續工業體系過渡與循環經濟的各種途徑。
description.describe_eh: To achieve the development of a sustainable society, the industrial and service sectors must understand how to respond to environmental, economic, and social challenges and change their behavior patterns. This course introduces the latest ideas and knowledge in this field and explores various pathways to accelerate the transition towards a sustainable industrial system and circular economy.

targets.describe_ch: 能夠運用課堂所學理論於實務及具有國際觀。
targets.describe_en: Be able to apply relevant theory in practice and have an international view.

targets.describe_ch: 具備有效溝通、團隊合作、發掘問題，以及解決問題之能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to have effective communication, teamwork, problem exploration, and problem-solving abilities.

targets.describe_ch: 具備邏輯思維、創新設計與持續改善能力。
targets.describe_en: Be able to have logical thinking, innovative design and continuous improvement abilities.

targets.describe_ch: 具備應用研究成果之整合能力並理解專業倫理與國際觀。
targets.describe_en: Be able to integrate applied research results and understand professional ethics and international outlook.
